top_signals.title: Ukraine Hits Russian Oil Refinery as 15 Attacked This Month
top_signals.summary: Ukraine said it hit yet another Russian refinery, this time striking a major fuel-producing plant in the Perm region, as the two countries continued to trade attacks on each other’s energy infrastructure.
